title: This Bird Has 5-Inch Dagger Claws. Guinness Calls It Most Dangerous

scenes.text: This bird has dagger claws five inches long.
It's the cassowary, and Guinness calls it the world's most dangerous bird.
It stands up to six and a half feet tall and can weigh 132 pounds.
Its legs are powerful, and its toes end in sharp claws.
Its inner toe carries a dagger-like claw, up to five inches long.
It can't fly. It doesn't need to.

description:
The cassowary has claws up to five inches long.
Guinness World Records calls it the world's most dangerous bird. It stands as tall as 6 feet 6 inches and weighs up to 130 pounds.
Would you want to meet one? Comment below.
